channel_split.question_regex: ^What are the online vs store sales amounts for the (?P<region>East|Midwest|Northeast|South|West) region\?$
channel_split.sql_template:
SELECT
  channel,
  SUM(amount) AS total_sales_amount
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE region = '{region}'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel;

quarter_growth.question_regex: ^How do Q3 \(Jul-Sep\) vs Q4 \(Oct-Dec\) sales compare for the (?P<category>Apparel|Electronics|Grocery|Home) category\?$
quarter_growth.sql_template:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q3_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q4_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS q4_minus_q3,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE
      SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
  END AS q4_to_q3_ratio
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE category = '{category}'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 12;

returns.question_regex: ^Which products in the (?P<category>Apparel|Electronics|Grocery|Home) category have the most zero-quantity orders\?$
returns.sql_template:
SELECT
  product,
  COUNT(*) AS zero_quantity_orders
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE category = '{category}'
  AND quantity = 0
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY zero_quantity_orders DESC, product ASC;

monthly_trend.question_regex: ^What are the monthly sales totals for the (?P<region>East|Midwest|Northeast|South|West) region in 2025\?$
monthly_trend.sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_date AS DATE)) AS month,
  SUM(amount) AS monthly_sales_total
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE region = '{region}'
  AND CAST(order_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND CAST(order_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

top_products.question_regex: ^What are the top 3 products by sales amount in the (?P<category>Apparel|Electronics|Grocery|Home) category\?$
top_products.sql_template:
SELECT
  product,
  SUM(amount) AS total_sales_amount
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE category = '{category}'
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

channel_count.question_regex: ^How many orders are there per channel for the (?P<category>Apparel|Electronics|Grocery|Home) category\?$
channel_count.sql_template:
SELECT
  channel,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM "default"."main"."orders"
WHERE category = '{category}'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel;
